You can get paid for getting confused by a website.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/website-user-testing/

In recorded UserTesting sessions, eligible participants try tasks and say what they are thinking. The useful output is feedback about the experience, rather than a polished performance.

Try this: Practise explaining one confusing checkout screen aloud, without exposing personal information.

You must qualify for individual tests. Invitations and earnings are not guaranteed.

Source: UserTesting participant guide. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

A paid online task can involve reviewing a legal case before a real trial.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/mock-jury/

OnlineVerdict recruits eligible people to review case material and give feedback. Its programme includes online case reviews as well as scheduled virtual and in-person mock trials.

Try this: Check the location and juror eligibility requirements before joining; distinguish a self-paced review from a scheduled session.

This is research participation, not appointment to a court jury. Selection depends on the case and participant location; this is not a worldwide offer.

Source: OnlineVerdict juror FAQ. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

Your next digital product could be a workflow, without building an app.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/sell-notion-templates/

Notion lets creators offer paid templates through its Marketplace, subject to review and payment eligibility. A focused workflow can be packaged as a reusable template.

Try this: Prototype a client-handover checklist for one kind of freelancer and test whether another person can use it unaided.

The example is a business experiment, not evidence of demand. Seller approval, fees, support and refunds still matter.

Source: Notion Marketplace seller documentation. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

A $10 spreadsheet needs more than 20 sales to repay $200 of your time.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/sell-spreadsheets/

Illustrative maths: assume 10 hours of work valued at $20 per hour, a $10 selling price and hypothetical fees of 10%. Each sale leaves $9 before tax and other costs. Twenty-two sales leave $198; twenty-three leave $207.

Try this: Calculate your own break-even sales before spending a weekend building a digital product.

These are assumptions, not a platform fee quote or an earnings forecast. Refunds, support and other costs would increase the target.

Illustrative calculation: InsightGinie original worked example; Gumroad is one possible selling platform. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

Photography has a route to revenue that does not start with growing followers.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/stock-photos/

Shutterstock accepts contributor photos and other creative work for licensing to customers. This is a marketplace route, where the asset and its suitability matter to a potential buyer.

Try this: Explore a small original photo collection around a specific business use, such as unbranded home-office details.

This is an experiment, not a claim of proven demand. Rights, releases, review standards and competition apply; uploads do not guarantee sales.

Source: Shutterstock contributor programme. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

You can sell something for a game without making the whole game.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/game-assets/

itch.io supports project pages for assets, soundtracks, comics and other downloadable work alongside games. A creator can package a small original asset collection rather than a complete playable title.

Try this: Build a consistent set of interface sounds or icons and include clear usage and licence instructions.

This is a product experiment. Use work you have rights to distribute; listing an asset pack does not guarantee buyers.

Source: itch.io creator documentation. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

Some paid research tasks look more like decision-making games than surveys.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/academic-studies/

Prolific describes participant tasks including decision-making games, questionnaires and AI evaluation. Researchers use different activities to study behaviour and improve products.

Try this: Check participant eligibility and give an accurate profile so studies can match your background.

Prolific uses a waitlist and verification. Tasks depend on study needs; this is occasional participation, not a guaranteed job.

Source: Prolific participant information. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

A paid trial lesson can leave the tutor with no lesson revenue.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/online-tutoring/

Preply currently states that its commission on a trial lesson with a new student is 100%. Later lessons have a different commission structure. The lesson price a student sees is therefore not the same as tutor take-home revenue.

Try this: Before setting a tutoring rate, account for trial lessons, preparation time and the current commission schedule.

This describes one platform’s published model, not all tutoring. Terms can change. Profile approval and student bookings are not guaranteed.

Source: Preply tutor FAQ and commission information. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

A short clip can be a product rather than a social-media post.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/stock-footage/

Pond5 gives video contributors a route to upload work, add searchable keywords and earn from sales. A clip can be offered as an asset for someone else's production.

Try this: Try a small original collection of clean establishing shots with accurate descriptions and clear rights.

This is a creative experiment, not guaranteed demand. Releases, technical standards, rights and contributor terms affect what you can sell.

Source: Pond5 contributor portal. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

A $500 freelance project can turn into $20 an hour before tax.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/presentation-polish/

Illustrative example: a client pays $500, you spend $100 on project costs, and the job takes 20 hours including calls, revisions and admin. The $400 left divided by 20 is $20 per hour before tax.

Try this: Quote a slide-deck cleanup with a fixed slide count and revision limit, then track every hour.

These are hypothetical figures, not typical rates. If extra fees apply or revisions expand, the effective hourly return falls further.

Illustrative calculation: InsightGinie original worked example; Freelancers Union resources. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

Your experience using a work tool can be useful to a paid researcher.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/research-interviews/

Respondent matches participants with research based on background, profession and interests. Some studies seek professional experience; others seek consumer perspectives. A specialist does not fit every study.

Try this: List tools you actually use and apply only to studies whose requirements you genuinely meet.

Screening is not a promise of selection or payment. Do not disclose employer secrets or customer data; check each study's terms.

Source: Respondent participant information. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

One paid audiobook hour can involve several hours of actual work.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/audiobook-narration/

ACX explains that finished audio includes recording, editing and quality checks. Its beginner guidance estimates roughly five to seven working hours for an hour of completed narration.

Try this: Record and fully edit a short sample, then measure total working time before judging a per-finished-hour offer.

The estimate varies by experience and project. Check country eligibility, audio requirements and payment terms; auditions do not guarantee work.

Source: ACX audiobook production guidance. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

You can publish a paperback without ordering a garage full of copies.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/self-published-workbooks/

Amazon KDP prints paperbacks on demand and deducts printing costs from royalties. Page count, ink and marketplace affect those costs.

Try this: For an original workbook idea, estimate printing costs and review the proof before deciding whether the price makes sense.

No bulk inventory does not mean no work or no costs. Quality, rights, discoverability and demand still matter; publication does not guarantee sales.

Source: Amazon KDP paperback printing guidance. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.

Evening Money Discovery · #WaysToEarn #FutureOfWork

The same design platform can offer two very different ways to pursue paid work.

The practical guide on InsightGinie:
https://insightginie.com/earn/design-competitions/

99designs offers both one-to-one client projects and design contests. A contest entry competes for selection, while a direct project begins with a specific client agreement.

Try this: Decide how much unpaid preparation you can afford before entering a contest or pitching a project.

Contest entry is not guaranteed paid work. Check prize, ownership and project terms; never treat all open contests as available income.

Source: 99designs designer programme. Reviewed 2026-10-20; original reference is in the guide.
